We will encourage public involvement and cooperation to identify present and future needs and solutions. Vision Statement Madison County, Montana, a place people are proud to call home. Core Values Integrity: The foundation of our mission is our commitment to honest, open and reliable government. We must remain open to challenge, differences and change, while being committed to shared values. Our integrity comes from our dedication to our pursuit of excellence. People: We value people. They are the reason for our mission and it is people who will help us fulfill our mission. Our employees are our greatest resource for achieving our mission of service. Service: Our purpose is to provide important and valuable services of high quality that build and strengthen our community. Our positive, professional service is central to our purpose and is our cornerstone value. Accountability: Madison County will encourage its employees and elected officials to demonstrate accountability, dependability and professionalism in the performance of their duties.
